text:
alejandra: deploy-bot reports embeddings p95 spike in us-west-2 at 30% canary (p95 +320ms). there are long-running customer evals in-flight. thinking suppress auto-rollback and throttle to 5%. @tom @chris?

deploy-bot: rollout=2025.03.14-beta2 status=CANARY_DEGRADED trigger=embed_p95 threshold=200ms auto-rollback=4m suppression_possible=true

tom: ok to suppress if we have a clear manual plan and quick rollback ready. who are the affected customers?

nina: acme-ai, atlas-research, synthlabs — CS pre-warned acme-ai.

chris: snapshot: p95=328ms, p50=42ms, error-rate low, embed_qps down 18%. suspect batching heuristic.

alejandra: plan: 1) suppress autorollback 2) scale canary -> 5% 3) try batcher flag tweak on canary nodes 4) if p95 > 400ms or error-rate > 0.5% -> immediate rollback.

tom: running suppression and scale: `redwoodctl rollout hold --id 2025.03.14-beta2 --reason "suppress for long-running evals"` and `redwoodctl rollout scale --id 2025.03.14-beta2 --region us-west-2 --replicas 1`

deploy-bot: hold accepted (hold-4421). canary traffic ~5%. auto-rollback suppressed.

chris: flipped `batcher.max_wait_ms` 15->5 on subset of canary nodes. their p95 dropped to ~210ms, but one node still high (~410ms).

alejandra: prepare rollback command and customer comm template in case.

tom: rollback prepared: `redwoodctl rollout revert --id 2025.03.14-beta2 --to v2025.03.13-stable --region us-west-2 --selector canary-slice --reason "embed throughput regression" --notify cs,infra` (queued, confirm required).

chris: after 8m avg p95 = 238ms, variance persists.

alejandra: decision: execute rollback to avoid disrupting evals. tom please confirm.

tom: confirming rollback: `redwoodctl rollout confirm --job rb-99422 --owner tom --message "manual rollback per canary instability"`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated, status=ROLLING_BACK, ETA ~70s.

oncall-bot: emergency rollback logged outside change window; oncall acknowledged.

nina: CS notified affected customers with targeted note offering to requeue evals.

chris: post-rollback metrics ~30s: p95 back to baseline (~63ms), embed_qps recovered.

alejandra: action items: runtime to triage batching variance, QA to add long-eval canary test, ops to document suppression flow and add deploy-bot guard for suppressed autorollbacks. marking release as `reverted - suppressed-autorollback`. closing after 15m stable. :white_check_mark:
